snippet.title: Past Due: Midnight - Official Teaser #2
snippet.description:
You weren’t supposed to stay this late.
Now the office won’t let you leave.

Past Due: Midnight is a first-person, dark action-adventure horror game by Ebon Crown Games. Trapped within the twisting halls of a once-familiar corporate office, players must navigate a place now shrouded in unease and lost memory. Uncover clues, solve puzzles, and do whatever it takes to escape the nightmarish corporate labyrinth. 

Past Due: Midnight is coming soon to PC (Steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4548250/Past_Due_Midnight/
